# FreeMCP

> FreeMCP is a community-curated directory of open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. It helps users find listings, inspect setup and security guidance, and locate upstream documentation.

FreeMCP operates a read-only directory API. The servers in the directory are maintained and operated by their respective projects. Check each listing's lifecycle and upstream instructions before installing.

## Discover servers

- [MCP server directory](https://freemcp.in/servers/): Browse, search, and filter published listings.
- [Registry API specification](https://freemcp.in/api/openapi.json): Parameters and response formats for machine-readable listing search, pagination, and category lookup.
- [Registry API](https://freemcp.in/api/servers): The first page of public listings in JSON.
- [Registry categories](https://freemcp.in/api/servers?meta=categories): Published listing categories in JSON.

## Learn

- [What is MCP?](https://freemcp.in/guides/what-is-mcp/): Learn how hosts, clients, servers, and tools fit together.
- [Install an MCP server safely](https://freemcp.in/guides/install-mcp-server/): Review compatibility, permissions, configuration, and testing.
- [MCP versus APIs](https://freemcp.in/guides/mcp-vs-api/): Understand how MCP servers and traditional APIs work together.

## Contribute

- [Submit a server](https://freemcp.in/submit/): Propose a listing for community review through GitHub.
- [About FreeMCP](https://freemcp.in/about/): Read about the registry and its curation process.

## Optional

- [Frequently asked questions](https://freemcp.in/faq/): Get answers about listings, installation, and security.
- [Sitemap](https://freemcp.in/sitemap.xml): Canonical public pages and listing URLs.
